## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change; link affected backlog IDs.

## Validation

- [ ] `sh scripts/check.sh` passes (attach command/result and commit).
- [ ] Valid, invalid, and unauthorized paths are covered as appropriate.

## Documentation and review

- [ ] Traceability and development record updated; partial work remains marked partial.
- [ ] README/configuration/dependency changes documented.
- [ ] Demo steps and known limitations described.
- [ ] One other team member reviewed; comments resolved; required CI checks pass before merge.
